prompt: By default the veo-3.1-lite model with a landscape 8-second clip will be used.

Veo 3.1 Lite, two variations. Lite makes 8-second 720p clips on every plan (4 and 6 seconds need Google AI Ultra). For all parameters see https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-videos
Image-to-video with a start frame (startImage) and an end frame (endImage). Supported by Veo 3.1 Lite and by omni-flash-1.2.

Omni 1.2 Flash is audio-native and makes 3 to 15 second clips (above 10 seconds on paid plans). Other models (veo-3.1-lite-low-priority, …) are selectable via the model field — see the POST /videos docs.
